name: ESTRO PLUS Tablet 21's
introduction:
Introduction About ESTRO PLUS TABLET

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is a combination of Dienogest and Estradiol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is used to manage acne and heavy menstrual bleeding in women who take medicines to manage pregnancy. It works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. Acne vulgaris is a condition where the hair follicles get blocked by dead cells, bacteria, and oil (sebum), causing blemishes, pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and cysts.

Acne vulgaris, also commonly known as common acne, is most common in people around puberty and pregnant women. It is due to hormonal changes that increase oil secretion, thus causing acne.

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in women with blood clots or a high risk of blood clots. ESTRO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with depression and varicose veins. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should not use ESTRO PLUS TABLET. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ESTRO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in post-pubertal female children under the age of 18 years and should be used with caution in elderly women. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common ESTRO PLUS TABLET side effects are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness, and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESTRO PLUS TABLET Works

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Dienogest and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and also promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. Progestin, present in ESTRO PLUS TABLET, works by managing heavy menstrual bleeding. ESTRO PLUS TABLET reduces the male sex hormone (testosterone), which reduces oil secretion (sebum), managing acne formation.
usageDetails:
How to use ESTRO PLUS TABLET

Take ESTRO PLUS TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. ESTRO PLUS TABLET can be taken with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. If you have any doubts regarding the doses, consult your doctor.

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases like heart attack, stroke, angina, mini-stroke, uncontrolled high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had blood clots in legs (deep vein thrombosis) and eyes (retinal thrombosis)
Have high risks of having blood clots such to obesity, family history, planned surgeries, age (above 35 years), new mothers who delivered four weeks ago
Have diabetes associated with blood vessel damage
Have a disorder affecting your blood clotting (protein C deficiency
protein S deficiency, antithrombin-III deficiency, and antiphospholipid antibodies in blood which cause immediate blood clots
Have or ever had migraine headaches
Have hyperhomocysteinaemia (an increase in the levels of an amino acid called homocysteine in the blood)
Have or ever had breast cancer or other cancers
Have unexplained bleeding from the vagina
Have any pre-planned surgery
Have adrenal (when the body does not produce enough aldosterone hormone)

Before taking ESTRO PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis (chronic inflammatory bowel disease)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (disease affecting your immune system)
Have haemolytic uraemic syndrome (blood clotting disorder causing kidney failure)
Have sickle cell anaemia (an inherited red blood cell disease)
Have an inflammation in the veins under the skin (superficial thrombophlebitis)
Have varicose veins (enlarged or twisted veins)
Have a family history of breast cancer
Have depression
Have epilepsy
 You smoke. Your doctor may advise you to stop smoking. If you’re older than 35 and you are unable to quit smoking, your doctor may advise you to use another medicine
Are obese (BMI more than 30)
Have a lab test
Have any pre-planned surgery

Use in paediatrics:

ESTRO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in post-pubertal female children under the age of 18 years. ESTRO PLUS TABLET it is not intended for use in male children and in female children who have not attained puberty. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

ESTRO PLUS TABLET is not indicated for use in elder women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ESTRO PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. primidone, phenytoin, barbiturates, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, nevirapine, efavirenz)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, griseofulvin)
Medicines used to manage arthritis, and osteoarthritis (Ex. etoricoxib)
 Herbal remedy St. John’s wort used to manage mental illness
Medicines used to manage graft rejection in organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporin)
Medicines used to manage hepatitis C infections Ex. ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of ESTRO PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting and withdrawal bleeding. Withdrawal bleeding may occur in girl children even before their first menstruation who have taken it accidentally.

introduction:
Introduction About INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET

INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET.

INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET. The most common side effects of INTIMACY PLUS 3MG TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About LOETTE TABLET

LOETTE TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy. It can also be used to manage acne vulgaris among adult women (aged 18 years or above) who wish to take oral contraceptives.

Before taking LOETTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

LOETTE TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

LOETTE TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and among elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking LOETTE TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How LOETTE TABLET Works

LOETTE TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.

It can also reduce the production of male sex hormones (testosterone) in the body. This helps in reducing excess oil production in the skin which in turn reduces hormonal acne.
usageDetails:
How to use LOETTE TABLET

Take LOETTE TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow LOETTE TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LOETTE TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of LOETTE TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case if you have missed a dose of LOETTE TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of LOETTE TABLET to compensate the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About OVRAL L TABLET

OVRAL L TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking OVRAL L TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

OVRAL L TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

OVRAL L TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking OVRAL L TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
usesDetails:
Uses Of OVRAL L TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How OVRAL L TABLET Works

OVRAL L TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use OVRAL L TABLET

Take OVRAL L TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow OVRAL L TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. OVRAL L TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of OVRAL L TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of OVRAL L TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

warnings.details: OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and in women who think that they might be pregnant. It is also not recommended for use in women who have or ever had jaundice due to pregnancy. It should be used with caution in pregnant women with a previous history of herpes gestationis (an autoimmune skin disease). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
OVRAL L TABLET has negligible effects on driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle any heavy machines if your ability is affected by OVRAL L TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking OVRAL L TABLET.

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had liver diseases (such as liver tumours). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver or gallbladder problems (such as jaundice, and gallstones). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take OVRAL L TABLET if you are allergic to Levonorgestrel or Ethinylestradiol.

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have blood clots in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had heart diseases (such as coronary artery disease, heart attack, angina, valvular heart disease, or arrhythmias). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had blood clots in legs (deep vein thrombosis) or eyes (retinal thrombosis)
Have any type of blood clotting disorders (such as APC resistance, protein C deficiency, protein S deficiency, antithrombin-III deficiency, antiphospholipid antibodies in blood which cause immediate blood clots)
Have any pre-planned surgery
Have severe diabetes with damage to blood vessels
Have uncontrolled high blood pressure
Have high blood cholesterol and triglyceride levels
Have or ever had migraine headaches
Have or ever had or at risk of developing breast cancer or cancers in genital organs
Have hyperhomocysteinaemia (an increase in the levels of an amino acid called homocysteine in blood)
Have unexplained bleeding from the vagina
Have pancreatitis (severe inflammation of the pancreas)
Have hepatitis C infection (a type of viral infection affecting the liver)
Have adrenal insufficiency (when the body does not produce enough aldosterone hormone)
Are aged above 35 years and have a habit of smoking
Have stroke or problems in blood circulation
Have reached menopause

Have family history of breast cancer
Have hypertension
Have depression
Have diarrhoea/vomiting
Have otosclerosis (abnormal bone growth in the ears)
Have Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis (chronic inflammatory bowel disease)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (disease affecting your immune system)

Have sickle cell anaemia (an inherited red blood cell disease)
Have just given birth
Had an abortion in the second trimester
Have been bed-ridden or immobile for a prolonged period
Have an inflammation in the veins under the skin (superficial thrombophlebitis)
Have varicose veins (enlarged or twisted veins)
Have epilepsy
Are obese
Have porphyria (a rare inherited blood disorder)
Have abnormal body movements (chorea)
Have multiple sclerosis (an autoimmune disease, causing nerve damage)
Have tetany (involuntary muscle contractions)
Have a history of chloasma gravidarum (dark patches on the skin) in previous pregnancies
Are due to have a lab test

Use in paediatrics:

OVRAL L TABLET is not recommended for use in children and in adolescent girls aged below 18 years. It is also not intended for use in female children who have not attained puberty. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

OVRAL L TABLET is not indicated for use in elderly women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking OVRAL L TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. primidone, phenytoin, topiramate, phenobarbital, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, felbamate, lamotrigine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin)
Dexamethasone (a medicine used to manage asthma or autoimmune diseases)
Atorvastatin (a medicine used to manage high blood cholesterol levels)
Modafinil (a medicine used to reduce sleep in narcolepsy)
Troleandomycin (a medicine used to manage bacterial infections)
Ascorbic acid (a vitamin C supplement)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, nevirapine, efavirenz)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. fluconazole, griseofulvin)
St. John’s wort (an herbal remedy used to manage mental illness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection during organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporin)
Theophylline (used to manage breathing problems)
Flunarizine (a medicine used to manage vertigo)
Medicines used to manage hepatitis C infections (Ex. ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir)
Medicines used to relive pain (Ex. ibuprofen, aceclofenac, phenylbutazone, paracetamol)
Heparin (a medicine used to manage blood clots)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more OVRAL L TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, dizziness, stomach pain, fatigue and withdrawal bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About CESTEL 30 TABLET

CESTEL 30 TABLET is a combination of Dienogest and Estradiol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is used to manage acne and heavy menstrual bleeding in women who take medicines to manage pregnancy. It works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. Acne vulgaris is a condition where the hair follicles get blocked by dead cells, bacteria, and oil (sebum), causing blemishes, pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and cysts.

Acne vulgaris, also commonly known as common acne, is most common in people around puberty and pregnant women. It is due to hormonal changes that increase oil secretion, thus causing acne.

CESTEL 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in women with blood clots or a high risk of blood clots. CESTEL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with depression and varicose veins. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should not use CESTEL 30 TABLET. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CESTEL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in post-pubertal female children under the age of 18 years and should be used with caution in elderly women. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common CESTEL 30 TABLET side effects are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness, and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How CESTEL 30 TABLET Works

CESTEL 30 TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Dienogest and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and also promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. Progestin, present in CESTEL 30 TABLET, works by managing heavy menstrual bleeding. CESTEL 30 TABLET reduces the male sex hormone (testosterone), which reduces oil secretion (sebum), managing acne formation.
usageDetails:
How to use CESTEL 30 TABLET

Take CESTEL 30 TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. CESTEL 30 TABLET can be taken with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. If you have any doubts regarding the doses, consult your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About DIENO PLUS TABLET

DIENO PLUS TABLET is a combination of Dienogest and Estradiol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is used to manage acne and heavy menstrual bleeding in women who take medicines to manage pregnancy. It works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. Acne vulgaris is a condition where the hair follicles get blocked by dead cells, bacteria, and oil (sebum), causing blemishes, pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and cysts.

Acne vulgaris, also commonly known as common acne, is most common in people around puberty and pregnant women. It is due to hormonal changes that increase oil secretion, thus causing acne.

DIENO PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in women with blood clots or a high risk of blood clots. DIENO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with depression and varicose veins. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should not use DIENO PLUS TABLET. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DIENO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in post-pubertal female children under the age of 18 years and should be used with caution in elderly women. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common DIENO PLUS TABLET side effects are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness, and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIENO PLUS TABLET Works

DIENO PLUS TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Dienogest and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and also promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. Progestin, present in DIENO PLUS TABLET, works by managing heavy menstrual bleeding. DIENO PLUS TABLET reduces the male sex hormone (testosterone), which reduces oil secretion (sebum), managing acne formation.
usageDetails:
How to use DIENO PLUS TABLET

Take DIENO PLUS TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. DIENO PLUS TABLET can be taken with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. If you have any doubts regarding the doses, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How FREEDASE 30 TABLET Works

FREEDASE 30 TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Dienogest and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and also promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. Progestin, present in FREEDASE 30 TABLET, works by managing heavy menstrual bleeding. FREEDASE 30 TABLET reduces the male sex hormone (testosterone), which reduces oil secretion (sebum), managing acne formation.

How to use FREEDASE 30 TABLET

Take FREEDASE 30 TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. FREEDASE 30 TABLET can be taken with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. If you have any doubts regarding the doses, consult your doctor.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking FREEDASE 30 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. primidone, phenytoin, barbiturates, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, nevirapine, efavirenz)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, griseofulvin)
Medicines used to manage arthritis, and osteoarthritis (Ex. etoricoxib)
 Herbal remedy St. John’s wort used to manage mental illness
Medicines used to manage graft rejection in organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporin)
Medicines used to manage hepatitis C infections Ex. ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of FREEDASE 30 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting and withdrawal bleeding. Withdrawal bleeding may occur in girl children even before their first menstruation who have taken it accidentally.

Introduction About INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET

INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET.

INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET. The most common side effects of INTIMACY PLUS 2MG TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About OVULOC TABLET

OVULOC TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. OVULOC TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. OVULOC TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing OVULOC TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with OVULOC TABLET.

OVULOC TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.OVULOC TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

OVULOC TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. OVULOC TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of OVULOC TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with OVULOC TABLET. The most common side effects of OVULOC TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How OVULOC TABLET Works

OVULOC TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Desogestrel and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. OVULOC TABLET works by suppressing hormones and managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.
usageDetails:
How to use OVULOC TABLET

Take OVULOC TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About QLAIRA TABLET

QLAIRA Tablet is used to stop pregnancy and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (not caused by any disease of the womb) in women who wish to use oral contraception. It is a combination of Estradiol valerate and Dienogest, which belongs to the group of medicines called Oral contraceptives. 

Take one tablet every day with water, with or without food. Do not crush or chew the tablet.

QLAIRA Tablet is not recommended to take if you have or have had blood clots, heart problems, diabetes, migraine, liver disease, tumours, or vaginal bleeding. Before taking QLAIRA Tablet, inform your doctor if you have or had jaundice, diabetes, depression, tumours, liver, kidney, gall bladder disease, a high level of fat in your blood, Crohn’s disease, sickle cell anemia, vein inflammation, epilepsy, or trouble with a previous pregnancy.

Your doctor might check your blood pressure and carry out other tests before giving you this tablet.

QLAIRA Tablet is used only by women. It is not recommended for use in women whose periods have not yet started or in women after menopause. QLAIRA Tablet is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Do not smoke while taking QLAIRA Tablet.

The most common side effects of taking QLAIRA Tablet are headaches, nausea, abdominal pain, acne, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor for further medical advice as soon as possible.

Therefore, consult your doctor before taking QLAIRA Tablet.

QLAIRA Tablet is not recommended for use in females whose periods have not started. There is no information available on the use of QLAIRA Tablet in children under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.
QLAIRA is not recommended for use by women who have reached menopause. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

QLAIRA Tablet is not recommended for use if you:

Have (or have ever had) a blood clot in a blood vessel of your legs (deep vein thrombosis), your lungs (pulmonary embolus), or other organs
Have a disorder affecting your blood clotting (for instance, protein C deficiency, protein S deficiency, antithrombin-III deficiency, Factor V Leiden, or antiphospholipid antibodies)
Need an operation, or if you have been off your feet for a long time
Have any of the following diseases that may increase your risk of a clot in the arteries: severe diabetes with blood vessel damage; a very high level of fat in the blood (cholesterol or triglycerides); (a condition known as hyperhomocysteinaemia)
Have (or have ever had) a type of migraine called ‘migraine with aura.
Have (or have ever had) cancer or suspected cancer of the breast or genital organs
Have any unexplained bleeding from the vagina

If you have a disease of the gall bladder
If you have diabetes
If you have depression
If you have Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis (chronic inflammatory bowel disease)
If you have systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE – a disease affecting your natural defense system)
Intolerant to certain sugars
If you have sickle cell anaemia (an inherited disease of the red blood cells)
If you have elevated levels of fat in the blood (hypertriglyceridemia) or a positive family history for this condition.
If you need an operation or are off your feet for a long time
If you have just given birth, you are at an increased risk of blood clots
If you have inflammation in the veins under the skin (superficial thrombophlebitis).
If you have varicose veins.
If you have epilepsy
If you have a disease that first appeared during pregnancy or earlier use of sex hormones (for example, hearing loss, porphyria, gestational herpes, or Sydenham’s chorea)
If you have (or have ever had) golden brown pigment patches, so-called “pregnancy patches,” especially on the face (Chloasma)
If you have hereditary or acquired angioedema
If you smoke
If you are overweight
If a member of your immediate family has had a heart attack or stroke at a young age (less than about 50)
If you, or someone in your immediate family, has a high level of fat in the blood (cholesterol or triglycerides)

Interactions

A. Drug-drug interactions

Antiepileptics (Ex. primidone, lamotrigine, phenytoin, barbiturates, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, topiramate, and felbamate)
Antituberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more QLAIRA, consult your doctor or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage include feeling sick, throwing up, and bleeding from the vagina, as well as severe diarrhea.

introduction:
Introduction About YAMINI TABLET

YAMINI TABLET is a combination of Drospirenone and Ethinyl Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Combined Oral Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy (contraception).

Both drospirenone and ethinyl estradiol are synthetic female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone). They reduce the chances of pregnancy by suppressing the release of gonadotrophic hormones that triggers ovulation (release of a mature egg from ovaries). They also reduce the thickness of inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow and alters the thickness of cervical mucus (a type of fluid produced by the cervix) which makes it difficult for the sperm to travel inside the uterus.

YAMINI TABLET may alter your regular monthly menstrual cycle, and so do not use rhythm or temperature methods to track ovulation, as they may not provide accurate results.

Before taking YAMINI TABLET inform your doctor if you have any family history of breast cancer or are suffering from depression. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol or migraine headaches.

Consult your doctor before taking YAMINI TABLET if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems or are suffering from blood clots. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

While taking YAMINI TABLET, your doctor may want to regularly monitor your health condition to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of YAMINI TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens. Also, inform your doctor if feel extremely depressed or have thoughts of harming or killing yourself.

Uses Of YAMINI TABLET
It is used to manage pregnancy in women
mechanismOfAction:
How YAMINI TABLET Works

YAMINI TABLET acts by suppressing the release of gonadotrophic hormones that are responsible for triggering ovulation (release of a mature egg from ovaries) and for a successful implantation of the fertilized egg. They also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow. Additionally, they can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use YAMINI TABLET

Take YAMINI TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow YAMINI TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. YAMINI TABLET can be taken with or without meals. Try to take YAMINI TABLET at the same time each day.

Do not miss any dose of YAMINI TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case if you have missed a dose of YAMINI TABLET take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of YAMINI TABLET to compensate the missed dose as it may lead to bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SEVISTA 30MG TABLET

SEVISTA 30MG TABLET contains Ormeloxifene which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective estragon receptor modulators. SEVISTA 30MG TABLET is used in women of reproductive age groups to manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding which is a condition that occurs when normal cycle of menstruation gets disrupted.

SEVISTA 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Ormeloxifene. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from tuberculosis and/or chronic cervicitis/hyperplasia (inflammation of cervix).

Before taking SEVISTA 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver problems (such as jaundice, severe hepatic dysfunction) and/or kidney problems.

SEVISTA 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy since the medicine has contraceptive effects. If pregnancy occurs while in management with SEVISTA 30MG TABLET, then it should be discontinued. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SEVISTA 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged 16 years and below). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking SEVISTA 30MG TABLET are acne (pimples), water retention and/or breast tenderness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEVISTA 30MG TABLET
Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
mechanismOfAction:
How SEVISTA 30MG TABLET Works

SEVISTA 30MG TABLET works by causing asynchrony in the menstrual cycle between ovulation and development of uterine lining which cause uterine lining to shed more slowly resulting in reduced of loss of bleeding thus managing dysfunctional uterine bleeding in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Take SEVISTA 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIQUILAR TABLET

TRIQUILAR TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking TRIQUILAR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

TRIQUILAR TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

TRIQUILAR TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking TRIQUILAR TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIQUILAR TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIQUILAR TABLET Works

TRIQUILAR TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIQUILAR TABLET

Take TRIQUILAR TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow TRIQUILAR TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TRIQUILAR TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of TRIQUILAR TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of TRIQUILAR TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

name: Miliana Tablet 21'S
introduction:
Introduction About MILIANA TABLET

MILIANA TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. MILIANA TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. MILIANA TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing MILIANA TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with MILIANA TABLET.

MILIANA TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.MILIANA TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

MILIANA TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. MILIANA TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of MILIANA TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with MILIANA TABLET. The most common side effects of MILIANA TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How MILIANA TABLET Works

MILIANA TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Desogestrel and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. MILIANA TABLET works by suppressing hormones and managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.
usageDetails:
How to use MILIANA TABLET

Take MILIANA TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET

DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
usesDetails:
Uses Of DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET Works

DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET

Take DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET is not indicated for use in elderly women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. primidone, phenytoin, topiramate, phenobarbital, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, felbamate, lamotrigine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin)
Dexamethasone (a medicine used to manage asthma or autoimmune diseases)
Atorvastatin (a medicine used to manage high blood cholesterol levels)
Modafinil (a medicine used to reduce sleep in narcolepsy)
Troleandomycin (a medicine used to manage bacterial infections)
Ascorbic acid (a vitamin C supplement)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. ritonavir, nevirapine, efavirenz)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. fluconazole, griseofulvin)
St. John’s wort (an herbal remedy used to manage mental illness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection during organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporin)
Theophylline (used to manage breathing problems)
Flunarizine (a medicine used to manage vertigo)
Medicines used to manage hepatitis C infections (Ex. ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir)
Medicines used to relive pain (Ex. ibuprofen, aceclofenac, phenylbutazone, paracetamol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more DIVACON 0.03/0.15MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, dizziness, stomach pain, fatigue and withdrawal bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About DELSY TABLET

DELSY TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. DELSY TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. DELSY TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing DELSY TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with DELSY TABLET.

DELSY TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.DELSY TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

DELSY TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. DELSY TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of DELSY TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with DELSY TABLET. The most common side effects of DELSY TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How DELSY TABLET Works

DELSY TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Desogestrel and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. DELSY TABLET works by suppressing hormones and managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.
usageDetails:
How to use DELSY TABLET

Take DELSY TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DUOLUTON L TABLET

DUOLUTON L TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking DUOLUTON L TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

DUOLUTON L TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

DUOLUTON L TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking DUOLUTON L TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUOLUTON L TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How DUOLUTON L TABLET Works

DUOLUTON L TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use DUOLUTON L TABLET

Take DUOLUTON L TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow DUOLUTON L TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DUOLUTON L TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of DUOLUTON L TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of DUOLUTON L TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About JULIANA TABLET

JULIANA TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal contraceptive agents. JULIANA TABLET is a contraceptive pill used to manage pregnancy. JULIANA TABLET works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.

Contraception, also known as birth control, is used to manage pregnancy, but there are also other options available other than contraceptives to manage pregnancy. It can be achieved by a device, a medication, a procedure, or a behaviour. Contraception improves women’s reproductive health and their ability to be active participants in family planning.

Before prescribing JULIANA TABLET, your doctor will ask you about your past and present medical history and family history. Your doctor will check your blood pressure and blood glucose levels and perform a physical examination to rule out conditions like blood clots in the body and breast and liver cancer. A pap smear test will be conducted for sexually active women. Your doctor will advise you to visit for regular check-ups while on management with JULIANA TABLET.

JULIANA TABLET is not recommended for use in women who have blood clots in their bodies or in patients who are at high risk of getting a blood clot: those with diabetes that affects blood vessels, cancer, migraine headaches, being immobile for an extended period, scheduled surgery, if you are over 35 years old, if you smoke, if you have heart disease, and patients with liver diseases.JULIANA TABLET should be used with caution in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, anaemia, varicose veins, blood disorders, obesity, hereditary angioedema, and diabetes.

JULIANA TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. If you are found to be pregnant, stop taking the medicine and consult your doctor immediately. JULIANA TABLET is not intended for use by post-menopausal women. There is no data on the use of JULIANA TABLET in children and adolescents under the age of 18. It is not recommended for use in male children. 

Avoid concomitant use of Hepatitis drugs such as ombitasvir, paritaprevir, ritonavir and dasabuvir along with JULIANA TABLET. The most common side effects of JULIANA TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache.

mechanismOfAction:
How JULIANA TABLET Works

JULIANA TABLET is an oral contraceptive medicine that works by managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies. Desogestrel and Estradiol are both synthetic forms of the female sex hormones progesterone and oestrogen that work together to manage egg release from the ovaries (ovulation) by suppressing the hormone responsible for ovulation and promoting changes in the uterine thickening and mucus membrane. These changes make it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and implant the fertilised egg. JULIANA TABLET works by suppressing hormones and managing unwanted or unplanned pregnancies.
usageDetails:
How to use JULIANA TABLET

Take JULIANA TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Do not miss any doses between the courses because the management may not be effective if any doses are missed. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. In case you have missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it. Missing doses cause bleeding or spotting. JULIANA TABLETis not intended for use in post-menopause women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET

NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET contains Ormeloxifene which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective estragon receptor modulators. NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET is used in women of reproductive age groups to manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding which is a condition that occurs when normal cycle of menstruation gets disrupted.

NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Ormeloxifene. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from tuberculosis and/or chronic cervicitis/hyperplasia (inflammation of cervix).

Before taking NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver problems (such as jaundice, severe hepatic dysfunction) and/or kidney problems.

NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy since the medicine has contraceptive effects. If pregnancy occurs while in management with NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET, then it should be discontinued. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged 16 years and below). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET are acne (pimples), water retention and/or breast tenderness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
usesDetails:

Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET Works

NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET works by causing asynchrony in the menstrual cycle between ovulation and development of uterine lining which cause uterine lining to shed more slowly resulting in reduced of loss of bleeding thus managing dysfunctional uterine bleeding in affected individuals.

Take NOVEX DS 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: SUVIDA 72 Tablet 1's
introduction:
Introduction About SUVIDA 72 TABLET

SUVIDA 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

SUVIDA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

SUVIDA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. SUVIDA 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking SUVIDA 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. SUVIDA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking SUVIDA 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

SUVIDA 72 TABLET works by managing the release and fertilization (when sperm unite with an egg) or of the egg from the ovary, or by managing the attachment of a fertilized egg to the uterus (implantation).

Take SUVIDA 72 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take SUVIDA 72 TABLET within 72 hours after unprotected sexual intercourse. Swallow the medicine with water and do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About POSTPONE 72 TABLET

POSTPONE 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

POSTPONE 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

POSTPONE 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. POSTPONE 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking POSTPONE 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. POSTPONE 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking POSTPONE 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

name: Doris Tablet 21'S
introduction:
Introduction About DORIS TABLET

DORIS TABLET is a combination of Drospirenone and Ethinyl Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Combined Oral Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy (contraception).

Both drospirenone and ethinyl estradiol are synthetic female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone). They reduce the chances of pregnancy by suppressing the release of gonadotrophic hormones that triggers ovulation (release of a mature egg from ovaries). They also reduce the thickness of inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow and alters the thickness of cervical mucus (a type of fluid produced by the cervix) which makes it difficult for the sperm to travel inside the uterus.

DORIS TABLET may alter your regular monthly menstrual cycle, and so do not use rhythm or temperature methods to track ovulation, as they may not provide accurate results.

Before taking DORIS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any family history of breast cancer or are suffering from depression. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol or migraine headaches.

Consult your doctor before taking DORIS TABLET if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems or are suffering from blood clots. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

While taking DORIS TABLET, your doctor may want to regularly monitor your health condition to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of DORIS TABLET are unusual spotting or bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens. Also, inform your doctor if feel extremely depressed or have thoughts of harming or killing yourself.
uses: It is used to manage pregnancy in women
usesDetails:
Uses Of DORIS TABLET
It is used to manage pregnancy in women
mechanismOfAction:
How DORIS TABLET Works

DORIS TABLET acts by suppressing the release of gonadotrophic hormones that are responsible for triggering ovulation (release of a mature egg from ovaries) and for a successful implantation of the fertilized egg. They also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow. Additionally, they can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use DORIS TABLET

Take DORIS TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow DORIS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DORIS TABLET can be taken with or without meals. Try to take DORIS TABLET at the same time each day.

Do not miss any dose of DORIS TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case if you have missed a dose of DORIS TABLET take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of DORIS TABLET to compensate the missed dose as it may lead to bleeding or spotting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

It should be used with caution in women who developed pregnancy patches (golden brown patches in face), hearing loss, porphyria, skin itching with rash and blisters or sudden movements of the body (Sydenham’s chorea) during her pregnancy or after use of certain sex hormones. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
DORIS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, tiredness, or blurred vision after taking DORIS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DORIS TABLET.
DORIS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DORIS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or every had liver diseases (such as liver tumours). It should be used with caution in patients with gall bladder problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DORIS TABLET if you are allergic to Drospirenone or Ethinyl Estradiol.
DORIS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clots in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DORIS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had heart diseases (such as heart attack, stroke, angina, mini stroke, or uncontrolled high blood pressure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DORIS TABLET should be used with caution in post pubertal female children aged below 18 years. It is not intended for use in male children and in female children who have not attained puberty. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
DORIS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have or had blood clots in the legs (deep vein thrombosis)
Have any type of blood clotting disorders (such as protein C deficiency
protein S deficiency, antithrombin-III deficiency, antiphospholipid antibodies in blood which cause immediate blood clots)
Have any pre planned surgery
Have been bed-ridden or immobile for a long time
Have severe diabetes with damage in blood vessels
Have high blood cholesterol and triglyceride levels
Have or ever had migraine headaches
Have or ever had or at risk of developing breast cancer or cancers in genital organs
Have hyperhomocysteinaemia (an increase in the levels of an amino acid called homocysteine in blood)
Have unexplained bleeding from the vagina
Have hepatitis C infection (a type of viral infection affecting the liver)
Have adrenal insufficiency (when body does not produce enough aldosterone hormone)
Are aged above 35 years and have a habit of smoking

Before taking DORIS TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have family history of breast cancer
Have depression
Have Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis (chronic inflammatory bowel disease)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (disease affecting your immune system)
Have haemolytic uraemic syndrome (blood clotting disorder causing kidney failure)
Have sickle cell anaemia (an inherited red blood cell disease)
Have just given birth
Have an inflammation in the veins under the skin (superficial thrombophlebitis)
Have varicose veins (enlarged or twisted veins)
Have epilepsy
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (a life-threatening auto-immune disease)
Are obese
Are due to have a lab test

introduction:
Introduction About CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET

CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET contains Misoprostol which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin Analogs. It is used to manage peptic ulcer, predominantly caused due to excessive NSAID use (such as diclofenac, naproxen).

It can also be used for cervical ripening (dilation) prior to certain uterine procedures and for inducing labour pain. It is also used in combination with mifepristone (an abortion pill) to induce abortion during the early stages of pregnancy (first trimester) and can manage excessive blood loss after childbirth.

Take CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Avoid taking antacids (containing magnesium) along with this medicine as it may increase the risk of severe stomach problems.

Before taking CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET inform your doctor if you previously delivered your baby via caesarean section. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, high or low blood pressure, inflammatory bowel diseases or problems in blood vessels as a precaution.

Pregnant women should not get themselves exposed to this medicine as it may cause abortion or serious birth defects in the growing baby. It is also not suitable for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant while taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET are skin rashes, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, bloating, indigestion, birth defects (if accidentally exposed during pregnancy), vaginal bleeding (even after menopause) and severe uterine cramps. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
