mechanismOfAction:
How CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET Works

CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET reduces excessive stomach acid secretion caused due to prolonged NSAIDs use. This action heals the existing ulcers, manages new ulcers formation and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity and heartburn).

It also stimulates the contraction of uterine muscles which helps in initiating labour pain, reducing postpartum bleeding and for inducing abortion during the early stages of pregnancy. It also degrades the cells and tissues around the cervix, which helps in cervical ripening (softening) prior to uterine procedures.

How to use CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET

Take CYTOLOG 200MCG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: GRAVIFEM Tablet 21's
introduction:
Introduction About GRAVIFEM TABLET

GRAVIFEM TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking GRAVIFEM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

GRAVIFEM TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

GRAVIFEM TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking GRAVIFEM TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
usesDetails:
Uses Of GRAVIFEM TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How GRAVIFEM TABLET Works

GRAVIFEM TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use GRAVIFEM TABLET

Take GRAVIFEM TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow GRAVIFEM TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. GRAVIFEM TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of GRAVIFEM TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of GRAVIFEM TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

GRAVIFEM TABLET is not indicated for use in elderly women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CO PILL TABLET

CO PILL TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

CO PILL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

CO PILL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. CO PILL TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking CO PILL TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. CO PILL TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking CO PILL TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

name: VOVASURE Tablet 28's
introduction:
Introduction About VOVASURE TABLET

VOVASURE TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. VOVASURE TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

VOVASURE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking VOVASURE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

VOVASURE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking VOVASURE TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How VOVASURE TABLET Works

VOVASURE TABLET contains precursor of ovarian hormones (responsible for menstruation and reproduction in women) which replaces natural Estradiol hormone in the body that helps in maintaining adequate level of circulating hormones thus providing relief from vasomotor symptoms (such as hot flashes) in post-menopausal women.
usageDetails:
How to use VOVASURE TABLET

Take VOVASURE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PRONTA 72 TABLET

PRONTA 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

PRONTA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

PRONTA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. PRONTA 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking PRONTA 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. PRONTA 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking PRONTA 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About EDVAL 2MG TABLET

EDVAL 2MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. EDVAL 2MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

EDVAL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking EDVAL 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

EDVAL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking EDVAL 2MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EDVAL 2MG TABLET Works

EDVAL 2MG TABLET contains precursor of ovarian hormones (responsible for menstruation and reproduction in women) which replaces natural Estradiol hormone in the body that helps in maintaining adequate level of circulating hormones thus providing relief from vasomotor symptoms (such as hot flashes) in post-menopausal women.
usageDetails:
How to use EDVAL 2MG TABLET

Take EDVAL 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have/had thrombosis (blood clot in a vein) such as deep venous thrombosis
Have blood clotting disorder such as protein C/protein S/antithrombin deficiency
Have/recently had blood clots in arteries such as stroke
Suffer from inherited porphyria (rare blood disorder)

Suffer from high blood pressure, diabetes, gallstones, migraine/severe headaches
Suffer from systemic lupus erythematosus (disease of the immune system that affects many organs of the body)
Suffer from epilepsy
Suffer from otosclerosis (disease affecting eardrum and hearing), hereditary and acquired angioedema
Are scheduled for any surgery

EDVAL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women.

Use in Geriatrics:

EDVAL 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) due to increased risk of developing heart disease.  Consult your doctor before taking EDVAL 2MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ONE 72 PILL TABLET

ONE 72 PILL TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

ONE 72 PILL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

ONE 72 PILL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. ONE 72 PILL TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking ONE 72 PILL TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. ONE 72 PILL TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking ONE 72 PILL TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About NOFEAR 72 TABLET

NOFEAR 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

NOFEAR 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

NOFEAR 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. NOFEAR 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking NOFEAR 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. NOFEAR 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking NOFEAR 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

How NOFEAR 72 TABLET Works

Take NOFEAR 72 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take NOFEAR 72 TABLET within 72 hours after unprotected sexual intercourse. Swallow the medicine with water and do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVEX TABLET

NOVEX TABLET contains Ormeloxifene which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective estragon receptor modulators. NOVEX TABLET is used in women of reproductive age groups to manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding which is a condition that occurs when normal cycle of menstruation gets disrupted.

NOVEX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Ormeloxifene. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from tuberculosis and/or chronic cervicitis/hyperplasia (inflammation of cervix).

Before taking NOVEX TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver problems (such as jaundice, severe hepatic dysfunction) and/or kidney problems.

NOVEX TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy since the medicine has contraceptive effects. If pregnancy occurs while in management with NOVEX TABLET, then it should be discontinued. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

NOVEX TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged 16 years and below). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking NOVEX TABLET are acne (pimples), water retention and/or breast tenderness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVEX TABLET
Manage dysfunctional uterine bleeding in women of reproductive age groups
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVEX TABLET Works

NOVEX TABLET works by causing asynchrony in the menstrual cycle between ovulation and development of uterine lining which cause uterine lining to shed more slowly resulting in reduced of loss of bleeding thus managing dysfunctional uterine bleeding in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVEX TABLET

Take NOVEX TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
